answers.answer: Below seven newton metres the joint loosens under vibration. Above eleven newton metres the flange thread strips. The rating sits at nine.
Overtightening strips the thread immediately, in the shop, where it is caught and cheap. Undertightening passes inspection and fails later in the field under vibration.
accept: undertightening passes inspection and fails later in service

answers.answer: Establish that the seat was clean before the halves were brought together, because the check inherits any error in the seat and reports it as misalignment.
accept: check whether the seat was clean
because seat error propagates into the alignment reading
